versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Introduces one-time checks of explicitly provided public HTTPS URLs.

- Checks up to five URLs for GET status, redirects, elapsed time, verified TLS, and basic HTML SEO fields.
- Saves structured JSON and readable Markdown reports in the approved workspace.
- Restricts requests to public HTTPS hosts with bounded redirects, time, and response size.
- Clarifies limitations: no crawling, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, or JavaScript rendering.
